props.name: variant
props.note: `line` for pure trend; `bar` when each period counts on its own.

props.name: label
props.note: What the screen reader announces.

props.name: size
props.note: The web names.

props.name: children
props.note: The long content.

props.name: classNames
props.note: Class per part: `content` (the clipping box) and `trigger` (the button).

props.name: defaultOpen
props.note: Open on first paint, uncontrolled.

props.name: fadeOver
props.note: The background the block sits on, for the fade to blend into it: on the phone there is no mask, and the fade is painted in the background color.

props.name: labels
props.type: { more?: string | undefined; less?: string | undefined; }
props.note: The button texts, the same as the web.

props.name: maxHeight
props.note: The collapsed height, in points.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.note: Receives the new state on every tap on "Ler mais" and "Ler menos".

props.name: open
props.note: Open, for controlled use.

props.name: align
props.note: Alignment on the cross axis.

props.name: direction
props.note: The children's axis.

props.name: gap
props.note: The gap between children, on the house scale: `xs` 4, `sm` 8, `md` 12, `lg` 16 and `xl` 24 points.

props.name: justify
props.note: Distribution on the main axis.

props.name: wrap
props.note: Lets the children wrap when they do not fit.

props.name: value
props.note: Already formatted, as on the web: abbreviated money, raw count.

props.name: chart
props.note: The trend slot, when there is a native chart to put there.

props.name: deltaFormat
props.note: How the change is written: the name of a house formatter (`percent`, `currencyShort`, `integer`...) or your own function, the same vocabulary as the web.

props.name: invert
props.note: Rising is bad here: overdue items, cost, default rate.

props.name: step
props.note: Index of the current step, counting from zero.

props.name: labels
props.note: The component's texts, to change the language: `position` is the "Passo 2 de 5" count, which receives the current step counting from 1 and the total.

props.name: children
props.note: The visible label, on the same line as the switch; tapping it also toggles.

props.name: className
props.note: Styles the ROW (label + switch); without a label there is nothing to style.

props.name: classNames
props.note: Class per part: `label`, the text beside it.

props.name: label
props.note: The spoken name, required when there are no `children`.

props.name: value
props.note: The current tags.

props.name: className
props.note: Styles the whole box, the same node as `classNames.field`.

props.name: classNames
props.note: Class per part: `field` (the box), `tag` (each tag), `remove` (the tag's X) and `input` (the typing field).

props.name: labels
props.note: What the screen reader hears on the component's buttons, as on the web and in FilterChip.

props.name: max
props.note: Tag cap.

props.name: separators
props.note: What closes a tag besides Enter.

props.name: font
props.note: Which of the provider's three families styles this text: `sans` for running text, `display` for headings, `mono` where fixed width aligns a column.

props.name: lineClamp
props.note: Truncates after that many lines, from 1 to 6.

props.name: size
props.note: The body size on the house scale, from `xs` (12px) to `lg` (18px); above that is `Heading`.

props.name: tone
props.note: The color role, the same eight as the web.

props.name: truncate
props.note: Truncates to one line with an ellipsis at the end.

props.name: weight
props.note: The font weight, read from the theme weight tokens: `regular` is `--rc-weight-regular`, `medium` is `--rc-weight-medium`, `semibold` is `--rc-weight-strong` and `bold` is `--rc-weight-bold`.

props.name: onValueChange
props.note: Receives the text on every keystroke, like the web Textarea `onValueChange`.

props.name: rows
props.note: Initial height in rows; the field grows with the content.

props.name: font
props.note: The provider family that styles what is typed.

props.name: label
props.note: The name the screen reader announces, and what the two step buttons repeat: "Horario da entrega".

props.name: onValueChange
props.note: Called only with a whole time: `"08:30"`, or `""` when the field empties.

props.name: value
props.note: The chosen time, in 24h and always `"HH:MM"`.

props.name: className
props.note: Styles the frame that joins the two buttons and the field.

props.name: invalid
props.note: Paints the field as an error by an outside decision; without it the field decides on its own.

props.name: max
props.note: Last time of the window, in `"HH:MM"`.

props.name: min
props.note: First time of the window, in `"HH:MM"`.

props.name: placeholder
props.note: The gray pattern of the empty field.

props.name: step
props.note: How many minutes the plus and minus buttons move, landing on the grid.

props.name: label
props.note: What the line tells: "Histórico da nota 4471".

props.name: label
props.note: What the screen reader announces on the trigger, and the sheet title.

props.name: onValueChange
props.note: Called only with a whole time, the same way as in `TimeField`.

props.name: value
props.note: The chosen time, in 24h and always `"HH:MM"`.

props.name: className
props.note: Styles the trigger, the same node as `classNames.trigger`.

props.name: classNames
props.note: Class per part: `trigger` (the trigger), `panel` (the sheet), `column` (the list of each column) and `option` (each hour and each minute).

props.name: labels
props.note: The names of the two columns.

props.name: max
props.note: Last time of the window, in `"HH:MM"`.

props.name: min
props.note: First time of the window, in `"HH:MM"`.

props.name: placeholder
props.note: What the trigger shows with no choice: "Escolha o horario".

props.name: step
props.note: The minute interval the right column steps by.

props.name: value
props.note: The pressed values.

props.name: multiple
props.note: `multiple` accepts several at once; the default unpresses the previous one.

props.name: name
props.note: The tool name, as the model called it: `buscar_notas`.

props.name: status
props.note: Where the call stands.

props.name: classNames
props.note: Class per part: `trigger` (the header that opens it), `name`, `status` (the spinner and the badge), `panel` (the input and output), `error` and `actions` (the approve and reject buttons).

props.name: defaultOpen
props.note: Starts open.

props.name: error
props.note: The error sentence, when `status` is `error`.

props.name: input
props.note: The call arguments.

props.name: labels
props.note: The texts of the states and buttons, for another language or another tone.

props.name: onApprove
props.note: Called by the approve button, which appears only in `approval`, outside the panel.

props.name: onReject
props.note: Called by the reject button, which appears only in `approval`.

props.name: open
props.note: Open, controlled.

props.name: output
props.note: What the tool returned, with the same rule as `input`.

props.name: title
props.note: The human-readable sentence, below the name: "Consultando as notas em aberto".

props.name: onOpenChange
props.note: Called on finishing, on skipping and on Android back.

props.name: onStepChange
props.note: Called on every change: Voltar, Proximo and a step skipped for lack of a target.

props.name: step
props.note: The current step, counting from zero.

props.name: steps
props.note: The steps, in order.

props.name: className
props.note: Styles the sheet, not the mask.

props.name: classNames
props.note: Class per part: `mask` (the four dark strips around the target), `counter`, `title`, `description` and `footer` (the row of buttons).

props.name: labels
props.note: The texts of the buttons and the counter, to change the language or the wording.

props.name: onFinish
props.note: Called on Concluir of the last step.

props.name: onSkip
props.note: Called on "Pular tour" and on Android back, with the step where the person gave up.

props.name: topInset
props.note: The height of the top safe area, in points: `useSafeAreaInsets().top`.

props.name: label
props.note: What the strip measures, spelled out: "Emissões dos últimos 90 dias".

props.name: classNames
props.note: Class per part: `track` (the strip that receives the drag) and `cell` (each period).

props.name: labels
props.note: The component's texts, to change the language: `next` and `previous` are the names of the two adjust actions that move between periods.

props.name: items
props.note: All the items, on both sides.

props.name: onValueChange
props.note: Receives the new `value` on every move.

props.name: value
props.note: The `value`s of the chosen items, in the order they appear in the second list.

props.name: classNames
props.note: Class per part: `panel` (each list with its frame), `header`, `search`, `list` (the scrolling box), `option`, `actions` (the row of move buttons, below each list) and `empty`.

props.name: disabled
props.note: Turns off both lists, the searches and the move buttons.

props.name: labels
props.note: The component's texts, the same as the web.

props.name: searchable
props.note: Turns on the search at the top of each list, accent-insensitive.

props.name: label
props.note: The name of the top level: "Centro de custo".

props.name: value
props.note: Ids of the checked LEAVES.

props.name: emptyMessage
props.note: What to say when a level has nothing inside.

props.name: labels
props.note: The component's texts, to change the language: `back` is the name of the button that goes up a level, and receives the name of the level above; `selectAll` that of the box that checks a whole branch; `branch` what the screen reader hears on a branch, with the total of leaves and how many are chosen; and `enter` its hint.

props.name: multiple
props.note: Without it, only one leaf at a time and no branch gets checked.

props.name: label
props.note: What is being chosen: "Centro de custo".

props.name: value
props.note: Ids of the chosen LEAVES - the same contract as `Tree` and the web.

props.name: className
props.note: Styles the trigger; the sheet belongs to the platform.

props.name: labels
props.note: The component's texts, to change the language: `selected` is the summary with more than one choice, `empty` the sheet footer with no choice at all and `apply` the confirm button.

props.name: multiple
props.note: On by default, as on the web: a tree is almost always chosen by the handful.

props.name: placeholder
props.note: What the trigger shows with no choice.
